g.text: Map & Browse Flow - Public Shelter List + Leaflet Map (M4)
Public - no auth. GET /api/shelters?source=ALL returns every
community "does not exist" report) are absent from the public
list. Estonia-scale data (hundreds) - the backend deliberately
has no paging yet (fetch-all is fine).
leaflet map centered on Estonia (lat ~58.6, lng ~25.0, zoom 7).
One L.marker per shelter; markers for USER vs REGISTRY sources
get distinct icons; no clustering needed at this scale.
colours: the single orange marker (the --color-reported token)
with the third legend entry (Registry / User-submitted / Reported).
The trust-filter row under the source chips: a "Reviewed" toggle
Rating select ("Any rating" = no param / "1+".."5+" = minRating 1..5).
Every combination composes with the source chip - each change is the
same SERVER refetch + list rebuild, never client-side filtering.
Rows render the shared trust badges: the "Reported" badge, the
status-flag text ("Reported closed" / "Confirmed open") and the
occupancy text (firm or hedged band + recency) - only when the DTO
list(ALL, {reviewed: true, minRating: 4}) ' server-side trust filter
filtered markers + rows with trust badges
banner "map unavailable - is the backend running?"
click "View details" on the selected row
M4 keeps the list/map read-only. Submission ("+ Add shelter"),
detail and reviews arrive in M5 (verified accounts only).
